page_title: BUR 2-0 LEE | Burnley v Leeds 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Tim Robinson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' The linesman raises his flag. Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) is adjudged offside.
90+7' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar.
90+2' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+2' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+1' Joe Rodon (Leeds) is very close to scoring! He climbs high to meet a well-taken corner kick and sends it towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper shows good reflexes and stops the header.
90+1' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Leeds.
90+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Daniel James (Leeds), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
87' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Joel Piroe (Leeds), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
85' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Ashley Barnes (Burnley) coming on for Jaidon Anthony.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) is replacing Lesley Ugochukwu.
81' Substitution. Ao Tanaka (Leeds) replaces Ethan Ampadu.
80' A decent cross gives Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.

79' Joel Piroe (Leeds) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
77' Scott Parker decides to make a substitution. Zian Flemming will be replaced by Josh Laurent (Burnley).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anton Stach trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joel Piroe (Leeds).
73' Martin Dubravka (Burnley) is able to continue to play.
71' Martin Dubravka (Burnley) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches over the bar. He should have scored!
70' Daniel James (Leeds) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

68' 2 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. Karl Darlow just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:0.
66' Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Martin Dubravka is prepared to thwart his effort.
66' Here is a change. Jack Harrison is going off and Daniel Farke gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Nmecha (Leeds).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel James (Leeds) comes onto the pitch so that Brenden Aaronson can be given a rest.
64' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Jack Harrison (Leeds), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar.
63' Leeds have a corner.
59' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Jack Harrison (Leeds), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
58' Scott Parker is forced to make a change. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Loum Tchaouna.
56' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
54' The game is interrupted now, Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) is cautioned by the referee.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Tim Robinson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+1' Anton Stach (Leeds) attempts to threaten the opposition goal with the direct free kick. He unloads a thunderbolt strike directed to the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper stretches and makes a superb save!
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Referee Tim Robinson sees the trip by Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Leeds win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
39' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Leeds.
37' The corner is swung in but Leeds can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Leeds force a corner. They send men into the box.
36' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

32' A wonderful opportunity! Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the right side of the goal. However, Martin Dubravka makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the post.
29' Jack Harrison (Leeds) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
28' Josh Cullen (Burnley) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
21' Great teamplay by Leeds as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

18' 1 - 0 Goal! Kyle Walker hands Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
17' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
16' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
13' Tim Robinson blows his whistle after Joe Rodon (Leeds) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
11' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
11' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Karl Darlow.
7' Florentino (Burnley) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
3' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Leeds will kick the game off.
Tim Robinson is introduced as the referee for today's match.
